card.name: Slots where surgery or procedure words come next
card.fires_on: Short linking words, punctuation or digits just before a surgery or procedure term (laser surgery, cataract surgery, implant removal). It marks a position where a surgical word is likely to follow.

modes.label: Linking word before a procedure
modes.description: A small word such as 'of', 'or', 'such' or 'have' that leads into a surgical or imaging procedure.

modes.label: Surgery-related list or heading
modes.description: A word or symbol inside surgery, implant or eye-procedure text, before the next item.
modes.example: IS may increase the risk of eye complications during and after the operation. The benefit of stopping alpha-adrenergic antagonist therapy prior to cataract<< or>> glaucoma surgery has not been established

modes.label: Digits and spaces in dose text
modes.description: A digit or space inside a number in a dose or treatment line that sits near surgery headings.
